notes: Single-outstanding pending-request register links the A handshake to the D handshake (same-cycle A/D handled). The write mask for CHK-007 is OR of: pending write, write at the current A handshake, and writes whose D handshake was at E-1 or E-2. The shadow INTR_ENABLE is updated at the D handshake; the 'settled' flag makes CHK-006 apply from Ed+2. Both checks are disabled after an A handshake with i_a_intg_flip=1 until reset. The checks do not depend on the module parameters, so they run identically in all configurations.
